messages.subject: Shiny on R 2.14?  (httpuv dependency)

http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/shiny/index.html

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Shiny on R 2.14? (httpuv dependency)
parts:
Previous versions of Shiny used the websockets package, but in the current release, it switched from websockets to httpuv -- and Shiny's version dependency wasn't updated to 2.15. I believe that httpuv actually does require 2.15, but this is something that Joe can answer for sure after he's back online next week.

-Winston

messages.subject: Re: Shiny on R 2.14? (httpuv dependency)
parts: No, httpuv doesn't work with R 2.14 and therefore neither does Shiny. httpuv has a dependency on Rcpp which requires R >=2.15.1, sorry.
